cc:Work.dc:title: Archived model performance at K = 14
cc:Work.dc:description: Nine ROC-AUC point estimates with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals from the saved v3 CSVs. CatBoost has the highest point estimate, 0.8416, with interval [0.8252, 0.8575]. The dot plot uses a zoomed 0.80 to 0.86 axis. Full ROC-AUC, AP and F1 table in README.
